access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (T-3449) from the museum's open-access image. A blue tailcoat cut square at the waist, its tails to the back of the knee, a collar standing high behind the neck, long sleeves full at the shoulder; a buff waistcoat showing in the coat's opening; a black stock at the neck; full pale trousers to the instep strapped under black shoes. Real garments in colour, British, not American and not of Chicago.
note: One of the 1835 merchant reference set's pictures (data/people_match/reference_sets/merchant_1835.json); the companion trousers are object 83180 (https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/83180).
